extracted.intended_audience: EPO examiners and patent practitioners (applicants, attorneys), and other stakeholders in European patent prosecution
extracted.subtask_description: Comprehensive table of contents for the European Patent Office's Guidelines for Examination (Sept 2013), covering formalities, search, substantive examination, opposition, procedural matters, application content, patentability, and amendments. Used as the authoritative procedural and substantive standards for examination of European patent applications.

rubrics_metrics.name: Formalities Examination (Part A)
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance covering formalities examination of European patent applications, including filing, examination on filing, formal requirements, special provisions, amendment/correction, publication and request for examination, languages, drawings, fees, inspection of files and issuance of certified copies.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Each chapter of Part A sets the formal/administrative requirements applicants and examiners must apply during filing and formalities checks; full details are contained in the corresponding Part A chapters.

rubrics_metrics.name: Filing of applications and examination on filing
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirements and procedures governing how a European application is filed and how it is examined upon filing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Examination of formal requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Criteria and checks for formal requirements (e.g., content, signatures, formal form of documents) that an application must meet.

rubrics_metrics.name: Amendment of application; correction of errors
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedures and standards for amending an application and correcting errors during the formalities stage.

rubrics_metrics.name: Publication of application; request for examination and transmission of the dossier to Examining Division
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules and procedures for publication of the application and subsequent request for substantive examination, including dossier transmission.

rubrics_metrics.name: Languages
rubrics_metrics.description: Language-related requirements and derogations applicable to European patent proceedings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Drawings
rubrics_metrics.description: Formal requirements and standards governing drawings forming part of the application.

rubrics_metrics.name: Fees
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules concerning payment of fees, types of fees, and related formal requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Inspection of files; communication of information contained in files; issuance of certified copies
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedures for inspection of public files, communication of file contents, consultation of the Register, and issuance of certified copies.

rubrics_metrics.name: Search (Part B)
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on search practice at the EPO including characteristics, procedure, strategy, documentation, reports and opinions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Part B chapters define how prior-art searches should be conducted and reported by search examiners.

rubrics_metrics.name: Characteristics of the search
rubrics_metrics.description: Standards describing the nature and scope of a search to be performed (what constitutes an adequate search).

rubrics_metrics.name: Search procedure and strategy
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedural steps and strategic considerations for performing an effective prior-art search.

rubrics_metrics.name: Preclassification (routing) and official classification of European patent applications
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules on preclassification/routing of applications and official classification systems to be used.

rubrics_metrics.name: The state of the art at the search stage
rubrics_metrics.description: Definition and treatment of the 'state of the art' relevant at the time of conducting the search.

rubrics_metrics.name: Unity of invention (search stage)
rubrics_metrics.description: Criteria for assessing unity of invention when performing a search and implications for search scope and reporting.

rubrics_metrics.name: Subject-matter to be excluded from the search
rubrics_metrics.description: Categories of subject-matter that should be excluded from the search and the rationale for exclusion.

rubrics_metrics.name: Search documentation
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirements for documenting the search, including records of searches performed and cited documents.

rubrics_metrics.name: Search report
rubrics_metrics.description: Contents and format requirements for the search report issued by the EPO.

rubrics_metrics.name: The search opinion
rubrics_metrics.description: The search examiner's opinion on patentability-related matters based on the search findings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Procedural aspects of substantive examination (Part C)
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules and procedural guidance for substantive examination, from prerequisites to final decisions, including stages of examination and handling of replies.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Part C details the procedural flow and standards applied during substantive examination by Examining Divisions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Formal requirements to be met before the Division starts substantive examination
rubrics_metrics.description: Specific formal prerequisites that must be satisfied before substantive examination can commence.

rubrics_metrics.name: The first stage of examination
rubrics_metrics.description: Initial substantive examination steps, including identification of deficiencies and main lines of attack on patentability.

rubrics_metrics.name: Examination of replies and further stages of examination
rubrics_metrics.description: Standards for evaluating applicant replies and subsequent procedural steps during examination.

rubrics_metrics.name: The final stage of examination
rubrics_metrics.description: Criteria and procedures for concluding substantive examination and taking a decision on grant or refusal.

rubrics_metrics.name: Time limits and acceleration of examination
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules governing statutory and procedural time limits and options for accelerated processing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Other procedures in examination
rubrics_metrics.description: Miscellaneous procedural matters that may arise during substantive examination.

rubrics_metrics.name: Work within the Examining Division
rubrics_metrics.description: Internal organisation, division of tasks and practical working methods within Examining Divisions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Special applications (during substantive examination)
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedures for handling special types of applications (e.g., biological material, pharma, emergency cases) during examination.

rubrics_metrics.name: Opposition and limitation/revocation procedures (Part D)
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on opposition proceedings, substantive examination of oppositions, decisions, costs, and limitation/revocation procedures.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Part D sets standards for adversarial post-grant review at the EPO (opposition) and related limitation/revocation processes.

rubrics_metrics.name: The Opposition Division
rubrics_metrics.description: Role, composition and responsibilities of the Opposition Division in opposition proceedings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Opposition
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedural and substantive requirements for filing and pursuing an opposition against a granted European patent.

rubrics_metrics.name: Procedure up to substantive examination (opposition)
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedural steps before substantive examination of an opposition (filing, admissibility checks, preliminary matters).

rubrics_metrics.name: Substantive examination of opposition
rubrics_metrics.description: Criteria and standards applied when examining the merits of an opposition (novelty, inventive step, sufficiency, etc.).

rubrics_metrics.name: Procedure for the examination of the opposition
rubrics_metrics.description: Detailed procedural rules governing how oppositions are examined and processed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Decisions of the Opposition Division
rubrics_metrics.description: Standards for drafting and issuing decisions in opposition proceedings, including grounds and form of decisions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Costs (opposition)
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules relating to allocation and calculation of costs in opposition proceedings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Limitation and revocation procedure
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedures and standards governing requests for limitation or revocation of European patents.

rubrics_metrics.name: General procedural matters (Part E)
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules on communications, oral proceedings, evidence, time limits, appeals and other general procedural aspects of EPO proceedings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Part E contains cross-cutting procedural rules applicable across filing, examination and opposition stages.

rubrics_metrics.name: Communications and notifications
rubrics_metrics.description: Standards and procedures for serving communications and notifications in EPO proceedings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Oral proceedings
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules for conducting oral proceedings before the EPO, including scheduling, conduct and language issues.

rubrics_metrics.name: Taking and conservation of evidence
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedures for presenting, taking and preserving evidence relevant to EPO proceedings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Derogations from the language of the proceedings in oral proceedings
rubrics_metrics.description: Circumstances and rules under which derogations from the official language of proceedings are allowed in oral hearings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Examination by the EPO of its own motion; late submissions; third-party observations
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on when the EPO may consider facts or grounds of its own motion, treatment of late-filed evidence or grounds, and handling of observations by third parties.

rubrics_metrics.name: Interruption and stay of the proceedings
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules for interrupting or staying proceedings and the consequences thereof.

rubrics_metrics.name: Time limits, loss of rights, further and accelerated processing and re-establishment of rights
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedures concerning statutory time limits, loss and re-establishment of rights, and options for further or accelerated processing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Applications under the Patent Cooperation Treaty (PCT)
rubrics_metrics.description: Specific rules applying to European patent applications filed under the PCT route.

rubrics_metrics.name: Decisions
rubrics_metrics.description: General standards for decision-making and forms of decisions across EPO procedures.

rubrics_metrics.name: Appeals
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedural and substantive rules for appeal proceedings before the Boards of Appeal.

rubrics_metrics.name: Request from a national court for a technical opinion concerning a European patent
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedure for handling requests from national courts for technical opinions on European patents.

rubrics_metrics.name: Registering transfers, licences, other rights, etc.
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedures for recording transfers of rights, licences and other entries in the European Patent Register.

rubrics_metrics.name: The European Patent Application (Part F)
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules on the content and formal presentation of a European patent application, including sufficiency of disclosure, claims, unity and priority.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Part F contains the substantive content requirements applicants must meet for a valid application.

rubrics_metrics.name: Content of a European patent application (other than claims)
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirements for the description, abstract and other parts of the application distinct from the claims.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sufficiency of disclosure
rubrics_metrics.description: Standards for assessing whether the application discloses the invention sufficiently for a skilled person to carry it out.

rubrics_metrics.name: Claims (Art. 84 and formal requirements)
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirements for claims under Article 84 EPC and related formalities governing claim drafting and format.

rubrics_metrics.name: Examples concerning essential features
rubrics_metrics.description: Illustrative examples relating to identification and drafting of essential features in claims and description.

rubrics_metrics.name: Unity of invention (application)
rubrics_metrics.description: Criteria for assessing unity of invention in the content of the application and how lack of unity should be treated.

rubrics_metrics.name: Priority
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules and requirements for claiming priority and for assessing priority claims.

rubrics_metrics.name: Patentability (Part G)
rubrics_metrics.description: Substantive patentability requirements, including definitions of inventions, industrial application, novelty, inventive step, state of the art and treatment of non-prejudicial disclosures.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Part G sets out the legal standards and assessment criteria used to determine whether subject-matter is patentable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Inventions
rubrics_metrics.description: Definition and scope of what constitutes an 'invention' for patentability purposes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Industrial application
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirement that an invention be susceptible of industrial application and how to assess this criterion.

rubrics_metrics.name: State of the art
rubrics_metrics.description: Definition of the state of the art and its role in assessing novelty and inventive step.

rubrics_metrics.name: Non-prejudicial disclosures
rubrics_metrics.description: Circumstances under which disclosures do not prejudice novelty or inventive step (e.g., exceptions, grace periods).

rubrics_metrics.name: Novelty
rubrics_metrics.description: Standards and tests for assessing novelty of claimed subject-matter.

rubrics_metrics.name: Inventive Step
rubrics_metrics.description: Criteria and approach for assessing inventive step (non-obviousness) of claimed subject-matter.

rubrics_metrics.name: Examples relating to the requirement of inventive step – indicators
rubrics_metrics.description: Illustrative examples and indicators to assist in applying the inventive step assessment.

rubrics_metrics.name: Amendments and Corrections (Part H)
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules and standards governing the right to amend, admissibility and allowability of amendments (including Art.123(2) and 123(3)), plus correction of errors.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Part H provides the tests examiners and parties must apply when amendments are proposed during prosecution or opposition.

rubrics_metrics.name: The right to amend
rubrics_metrics.description: Legal and procedural basis for an applicant's or proprietor's right to amend the application or patent.

rubrics_metrics.name: Admissibility of amendments - general rules
rubrics_metrics.description: General criteria determining whether amendments are admissible procedurally.

rubrics_metrics.name: Admissibility of amendments - other procedural matters
rubrics_metrics.description: Further procedural issues related to admissibility of amendments in different proceedings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Allowability of amendments - Art. 123(2) and Art. 123(3)
rubrics_metrics.description: Standards for assessing whether amendments add subject-matter (Art.123(2)) or extend protection (Art.123(3)).

rubrics_metrics.name: Allowability of amendments - examples
rubrics_metrics.description: Worked examples illustrating application of the allowability tests for amendments.

rubrics_metrics.name: Correction of errors
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedures and standards for correcting errors in the application or patent documents.
